        no_input=True,
        password=None,
        directory=None,
    )
    assert repo_dir == str(template_dir)

    # Call determine_repo_dir with the zip file path

        template=str(zip_path),
        abbreviations={},
        clone_to_dir=tmp_path,
        checkout=None,
        no_input=True,
        password=None,
        directory=None,

    # The zip should be extracted into a temporary directory
